d: Born in Delhi, Vikas Divyakirti is a civil servant, educator, author and a lecturer. He was a member of Central Secretariat Service and now runs an UPSC coaching institute, Drishti IAS Coaching Institute in Delhi. A Master in Arts, Bachelor of Laws, Master of Philosophy, Doctor of Philosophy, Divyakirti cleared his UPSC Civil Services Examination in his first attempt. He also served as Section Officer at Dept. Of Official Language in Ministry of Home Affairs. Divyakirti was nominated for Padma Awards in 2023. He also appeared in Vidhu Vinod Chopra's '12th Fail', a Hindi Feature Film.
